response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior individual contributor with 15+ years across web, embedded, and infrastructure work, a genuine open-source track record (GISCollective, D-lang libraries), and solid Linux/DevOps exposure — all relevant to an open-source-focused consultancy. However, the role is an executive-level leadership position and the resume shows no formal team leadership, line management, or technical project management ownership; it also lacks evidence of IT architecture design at the enterprise level, UML/modeling, requirements management, IT security/compliance, or Python. Most decisively, the position requires German at C1 minimum for client-facing advisory work, and the candidate lists German as 'Basic', which is a hard-requirement gap. He could be an excellent senior engineer hire, but not a fit for Head of Development as specified.
strengths: Deep, broad 15+ year engineering background across many stacks and domains
Authentic open-source and Linux/self-hosted infrastructure experience, incl. founding a platform
Proven knowledge sharing: workshops, conference talks, and course design (mentoring potential)
concerns: German only 'Basic' vs. required C1 for client advisory work
No formal leadership, line management, or technical project management experience
Little evidence of IT architecture, UML modeling, requirements management, or security/compliance

key_factors.factor: Absence of leadership/team management track record
Strong open-source, Linux, and broad senior engineering depth
